title: The Slow Terminal Anew
author: Ivo Thackeray
blurb: Juniper Voss, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before the jump window closes.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
